prerequisite: lights-dependency-provenance.json describes the earlier unused RIL dependency removal. The brightness helper accepts the pristine original, that intermediate correction, or its own final output.
reason: The existing BACKLIGHT callback writes signed packed ARGB (e.g. -7303024) directly to lcd-backlight/brightness. The kernel rejects it; screen resumes at brightness zero. Android 11 LightsService supplies grayscale 0xffBBBBBB; reading the low byte exactly recovers its 0..255 brightness.
scope: Only the BACKLIGHT color-load instruction changes. All other code, ELF headers, symbols, dependencies and file size are unchanged relative to the dependency-fixed base. Nongray arbitrary backlight colors are outside this framework brightness contract; notification colors are unaffected.
validation: All 256 grayscale levels decoded correctly. A temporary file-bind overlay and Light-service-only restart on the booted phone produced positive brightness and passed three sleep/wake cycles, with actual brightness restored at the 0.5-second checks. The user confirmed power/home wake works. Overlay detached afterward; persistent install/reboot still required.
